title: Best Robotic Arm (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Selected products were taken from the CNET review of the Roborock Saros Z70 and the EVSINT list of top collaborative arms (Universal Robots UR20, Fairino FR20, Fanuc CRX-25iA, Epson SCARA Series, ABB IRB 1100, EVST ROBOTICS FlexArm S5).
assumptions: Prices are not provided in the sources, so no price caveats are included.
